title: Establish PRD Review Cadence and Dependency Ledger for Scope Amendments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Create a lightweight, repeatable PRD review cadence and a single-source dependency ledger that documents scope change requests, cross-team owners, and acceptance lanes. Goal is to reduce last-minute scope churn, shorten legal/design review turnaround, and provide a clear escalation path for high-impact changes. This ticket will produce: (1) a 6-week review cadence template, (2) a dependency ledger template (CSV + viewable Confluence table) and ownership map, and (3) an onboarding note and checklist for PMs to use when a PRD enters 'Scope-change' or 'Freeze window' workflows.
acceptance_criteria: A cadence template published in Confluence with weekly slots and owner rotation
Dependency ledger template created and accessible with sample rows for model rollout, telemetry, and data residency
Runbook documenting how to escalate a scope reversion within 48 hours
Sign-off checklist that names required reviewers (Eng, Design, Legal, Security) and expected SLAs for each review
Pilot executed for two active PRDs and retrospective notes captured
updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting with Eng/Design/Legal. Agreed on single ledger approach rather than separate spreadsheets.
2026-02-22: Draft cadence table created; Rowan to propose engineer rotation schedule by 2026-02-26.
2026-03-01: Legal requested a column for 'data residency impact' and examples of contractual clauses; added to template.
2026-03-04: Design asked for a UX-friendly view; created a Confluence table view and a downloadable CSV.
2026-03-08: Ran first pilot with PRD-frontend-perf (ENG-22011); observed review turnaround of 5 business days for design, 7 for legal. Need SLA tuning.
2026-03-10: PM retrospective: reduce legal SLA to 5 business days for non-contract changes; flagged high-risk items require '48hr emergency lane'.
decisions: Use Confluence as canonical ledger with periodic CSV exports for offline use
Adopt a 6-week cadence with a weekly 30-minute slot for near-term PRDs and a monthly 60-minute strategic slot
Introduce an 'Emergency 48hr lane' reserved for customer-impacting regressions or compliance blockers
Design will maintain a simple visual map of dependencies for each PRD; Eng will maintain technical owner tags
blockers: Legal headcount is limited in March; may require prioritization of contractual reviews
Access permissions for some Confluence spaces need to be updated for cross-team visibility
Need agreement on which PRD changes qualify for the emergency lane (PM + Eng + Legal consensus)
